adopt.assessment: no measured system is adoptable end-to-end: claude-mem measures at the firehose level on multi-record stores and cannot abstain, pi-lcm raw fails without its tool-level path, and agentmemory's 92.9% false-supersession disqualifies its write path as-is

compose.assessment: the evidence leans here: the S6-2 arms are complementary rather than ranked — pi-lcm abstains perfectly, bm25-class lexical retrieval is precise on retrieve cases, claude-mem contributes coverage — which is the roadmap's layered shape (canonical history + selective retrieval + state projection) assembled from existing pieces

build.assessment: buildable pieces exist (the transcript miner's correction-event schema, the S3-6 OM-ledger probe with tombstones and provenance), but nothing yet shows compose cannot deliver the state layer, so a build stays gated behind a compose attempt

phase_f.deciding_uncertainty: Whether a thin supersession/state layer over pi-lcm's tool-level retrieval can keep the measured perfect abstention while holding false-supersession far below agentmemory's 92.9% — that one unmeasured property is what decides compose versus build.
